svg.title: Experience
svg.desc: Experience: Lead Software Architect, MobileESports (Dec 2022 – now); Software Engineering Team Lead, Betsson Georgia (Mar 2026 – Jun 2026); Associate Partner, Software Development Chapter Lead, TBC Bank — Cards & Loyalty (Jul 2024 – Mar 2026); Software Solutions Architect, Raffle Management Platform (May 2024 – Oct 2025); Associate Partner, Software Development Chapter Lead, TBC Bank — Digital Bank Transformation (Apr 2023 – Sep 2024); Deputy Head of IT Department, Service Agency of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia (Nov 2020 – Apr 2023); Senior Software Developer, TBC Bank — Core Banking Modernization (May 2020 – Nov 2020); Software Solutions Architect, Greennet (Sep 2019 – May 2020); Senior Software Developer, Technical Lead, Softx (Jun 2018 – May 2020); Android Developer, Go Real Europe (May 2019 – Apr 2020); Senior Software Developer, Treepex (Nov 2017 – May 2018); Android Developer, Tbilisi State University — Online Campus (Sep 2017 – Dec 2017); Software Developer Intern, Ministry of Defence of Georgia (Jun 2017 – Nov 2017); Software Developer Intern, Revenue Service of Georgia (May 2016 – Jul 2016).
svg.text: Architected a global esports platform from the ground up: 35+ microservices, ~80 gaming products,
millions of users, 99.98% uptime and ~50 production deployments a week.
Led ~15 engineers across five product teams; drove the modernization roadmap, archived 300+
repositories, decommissioned 50+ services and moved logging to Datadog and secrets to Doppler.
Associate Partner, Software Development Chapter Lead
Led backend chapters of 10–20 engineers supporting 10+ product teams across cards, loyalty,
Designed the end-to-end architecture of a QR-code raffle platform with automated daily draws,
Associate Partner, Software Development Chapter Lead
Drove the insourcing of transfers, payments and accounts from vendor platforms; recruited 20+
engineers and supported the growth of 50+.

text.tspan: Service Agency of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia

svg.text: Led ~60 professionals delivering nationwide platforms for vehicle registration, driving licences and
firearms; 30+ integrations; legacy systems re-engineered into microservices.
Built backend capabilities for an in-house replacement of the vendor-provided B6 core banking
Application performance monitoring and observability consulting with Cisco AppDynamics:
Led delivery of an insurance management platform (Global Benefits Georgia), the silksport.ge media
platform, a salon booking platform and a document workflow system.
Sole Android developer of a customer-facing travel management application.
Customer, B2B and admin platforms, backend APIs and a native Android app for forest rangers.
Grant-funded mobile platform connecting students with the university administration.
Independently built Indact, a legal document management system adopted by the Legal Department.
Android application development within the IT Department.
